SOURCE: "The Canadian Summer Job Directory", 2006 and 2008 editions.
        Internet Archive items canadiansummerjo0000unse (2006) and canadiansummerjo0000unse_q4r4
        (2008), both at scan leaf 246. Both lending-restricted; NEITHER can be read from here.
        Assembled 2026-09-06 from ten overlapping Open Library search-inside windows.
        RECONSTRUCTIONS, not transcriptions.

The two entries are word for word identical except where marked. Nearly every query returned both
books at once, which is itself the evidence that the copy was reprinted rather than resubmitted.

  YMCA KAMP KANAWANA
  1435 rue Drummond, 4e étage, Montreal, QC        [2006]
  1435 Drummond, 4th Floor, Montréal, QC H3G 1W3   [2008]

  Summer Camp and Programs
  Description: YMCA Kamp Kanawana is located outside of St.-Sauveur-des-Monts, Quebec, about an
  hour North of Montreal. The camp is nestled in the heart of the Laurentian Mountains on
  500 acres   [2006]
  550 acres   [2008]
  of pristine wilderness with 3 private lakes. Kanawana offers programming for boys and girls
  aged 5 to 16, including canoeing, nature, hiking, sailing, rockclimbing, kayaking, swimming,
  ropes course activities, arts & crafts, drama[...]

  There are many positions available at YMCA Kamp Kanawana, including junior counselor
  (17 years), counselor (18 years and over), lifeguard, program specialist (such as canoeing
  specialist, sailing specialist[...]), maintenance assistant/counselor, office assistant,
  counselor-in-training director, out-trip director, assistant out-trip director, nature
  leader/counselor, head lifeguard/counselor, and counsellors.

  How to Apply: Online application package on their website [2006 window; the 2008 window breaks
  at "How to Apply:"]

THE ONE SUBSTANTIVE DIFFERENCE between the editions is the acreage: 500 in 2006, 550 in 2008, in
otherwise identical copy. Since this is the camp's own return to a commercial publisher, the
figure changed on the camp's own account between those two years.

WHAT WAS NOT RECOVERED: the tail of the activities list after "drama"; the parenthetical list of
program specialisms after "sailing specialist"; and the full How to Apply text.

A CAUTION ON THE PAGE. Leaf 246 carries several employers' entries. Windows returned from this
page also contained "summer director, assistant director, summer staff, cook, nurse", "equipment
coordinator, site/vehicle coordinator, office assistant and cook", "adventure program director
(ropes course manager)" and "assistant caretaker, assistant director, and head cook/food service
director". NONE of those is attributed to Kanawana here, because a directory page packs many
employers and adjacency in a twelve-word window is not attribution. Only the strings walked
contiguously from the Kanawana heading are given above.

QUERIES: "Kamp Kanawana" ; "YMCA Kamp Kanawana is located outside of St.-Sauveur-des-Monts" ;
         "about an hour North of Montreal" Kanawana ;
         "acres of pristine wilderness with 3 private lakes" ;
         "offers programming for boys and girls aged 5 to 16, including canoeing" ;
         "nature, hiking" Kanawana "aged 5 to 16" ;
         "junior counselor (17 years), counselor" ; "(18 years and over), lifeguard" ;
         "program specialist (such as canoeing" ;
         "counselor-in-training director, out-trip director" ;
         "assistant out-trip director, nature leader/counselor" ;
         "nature leader/counselor, head lifeguard/counselor" ;
         "sailing specialist" "office assistant" Kanawana
